blockers: The reused intro artwork actively contradicts and leaks the shipped mechanic: delivery_center.jpg visibly labels only three temperature categories (冷凍-18℃以下／冷蔵0〜10℃／常温10〜25℃), depicts foods already sorted by those categories, and places fish in the frozen compartment. The game instead requires four zones (冷凍-15℃／冷蔵5℃／冷蔵10℃／常温) and scores raw fish as cold5 only. Because schoolLunch.ts:388 displays this asset for logistics-lunch before the game, it can teach incorrect answers and bypass the legitimate 「？」 disclosures.
high: The existing truck tool description says the vehicle has only 「冷蔵室と常温室」, omitting the frozen compartment and the mechanically essential distinction between 5℃ and 10℃ refrigerated zones. This contradicts the four-zone decision model presented immediately afterward.

failure_codes.finding: The pre-game delivery-center artwork exposes food-to-zone associations and incompatible temperature labels before commitment, including fish under 冷凍-18℃以下 even though raw fish is accepted only in cold5 by the shipped rules.
The truck tool describes only refrigerated and ambient rooms, while gameplay requires frozen, cold5, cold10, and ambient zones.
